theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_lc_sl_lipschitz_leibniz
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2)) (RT : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2)) (RB : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (h : Euclid P → ℝ) (K : NNReal) (H : Euclid P → Euclid P), RT.Represents T → RB.Represents T.boundary → LipschitzWith K h → Measurable H → (∀ x, ‖H x‖ ≤ K) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[m + 2].restrict RT.carrier), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt (m + 2) RT.carrier x (approxTangentPlane (m + 2) RT.carrier x) ∧ H x ∈ approxTangentPlane (m + 2) RT.carrier x ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => μHE[m + 2] (RT.carrier ∩ ball x r ∩ {y | ε * ‖y - x‖ < |h y - h x - inner ℝ (H x) (y - x)|}) / ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ (m + 2))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), (∫ x in RB.carrier, (RB.mult x : ℝ) * h x * RB.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) x) ∂μHE[m + 1]) - (∫ x in RT.carrier, (RT.mult x : ℝ) * h x * RT.orient x (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) x) ∂μHE[m + 2]) = ∫ x in RT.carrier, (RT.mult x : ℝ) * RT.orient x (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin ((innerSL ℝ (H x)).smulRight ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) x))) ∂μHE[m + 2]
